source: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (the Digital Omnibus on AI); Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the AI Act)

claims.claim: Annex III high-risk obligations — where employment sits — moved from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027 by the Digital Omnibus on AI, Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, published in the Official Journal 24 July 2026 and in force 27 July 2026
claims.canonicalWording: Always name the instrument. 'December 2027' alone is insufficient — two tracks carried the bare date before the first library pass.

claims.claim: The deferral is not a repeal, and it did not move Article 50

Article 50 transparency duties — including disclosing at first point of contact that a person is interacting with an AI system — became enforceable 2 August 2026, independent of high-risk classification, and catch an organization running only a chatbot
claims.penalties: up to €15M or 3% of worldwide turnover

claims.claim: AI literacy obligation and the workplace emotion-recognition prohibition in force since February 2025

Article 26 deployer duties include use per instructions, competent human oversight assigned to a named person, input-data governance, logs retained at least six months, and incident notification — and cannot be contracted away
Article 25 transfers provider obligations to a deployer who puts its name on a high-risk system, substantially modifies one, or changes its intended purpose so it becomes high-risk
Article 26(7) works council obligations bind now
